summary.what_broke: The orders API stopped serving requests because the containers of the deployment orders-api were killed for memory.
summary.impact: Customers cannot place orders: the load balancer has no healthy targets and answers 503 since 14:20.
summary.scope: Only the deployment orders-api in the orders namespace of platform-prod is affected; the nodegroup and the database are healthy.

symptoms: The health check of orders.example.com returns 503
The target group of the load balancer has no healthy targets

causes.label: confirmed
causes.statement: The containers of the deployment orders-api are OOMKilled at their 256Mi memory limit after traffic doubled at 14:10, and restart in a loop (CrashLoopBackOff)

causes.label: candidate
causes.statement: The node group update of platform-prod, finished at 13:55, made the orders pods unhealthy

causes.label: candidate
causes.statement: The database orders-prod-db became unreachable, so the orders pods fail

hypotheses.statement: The containers exceed their memory limit under the higher traffic
hypotheses.prediction: Containers are OOMKilled with exit code 137 and restart in a loop
hypotheses.test: Read the pod states, the warning events, the memory limit and the container logs

hypotheses.statement: The node group update broke the orders pods
hypotheses.prediction: Pods fail at or soon after the update, or the nodegroup is unhealthy
hypotheses.test: Compare the time and status of the nodegroup update with the time the back-off began

hypotheses.prediction: The instance is unavailable or its CPU or storage is exhausted
hypotheses.test: Read the instance state and its metrics

actions.label: recommended
actions.title: Raise the memory limit of the deployment orders-api from 256Mi to 512Mi
actions.current_state: The container orders-api of deployment orders-api in namespace orders of cluster platform-prod has a memory limit of 256Mi and is OOMKilled
actions.required_state: The container has a memory limit of 512Mi and the pods stay ready
actions.change: Set the memory limit of deployment/orders-api in namespace orders of cluster platform-prod to 512Mi
actions.rationale: The containers are killed at 256Mi under the current traffic, and nothing else in the stack is unhealthy
actions.risk: Higher memory use per pod; nodes need room for three pods of 512Mi
actions.blast_radius: deployment orders-api in namespace orders only
preconditions: The nodes have 1.5Gi of free memory
verification: The pods of orders-api are Running and ready
The targets of orders-api-tg become healthy
rollback: Set the memory limit of deployment/orders-api back to 256Mi

actions.label: candidate
actions.title: Autoscale orders-api on request rate and size its memory from a load test
actions.current_state: The deployment has a fixed replica count of 3 and a memory limit that traffic doubling exceeds
actions.required_state: A horizontal pod autoscaler follows the request rate, and the memory limit comes from a load test
actions.change: Add a horizontal pod autoscaler to deployment/orders-api and run a load test to set requests and limits
actions.rationale: The request count rose above the range of one week earlier at 14:10 and the fixed capacity could not follow
actions.risk: More pods use more node capacity
verification: A load test at twice the traffic runs without OOMKilled

open_questions: What raised the traffic at 14:10, and can the team be told before the next rise?

not_checked.why: The triage role may not describe add-ons (access denied)
Only the orders namespace was read
